meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: 把解析好的结构化文档转成四色卡片：蓝卡列事实并附来源片段，绿卡作机制解释，黄卡标风险与过度声明，红卡给下一步建议。每张卡片都带来源和生成方式，可溯源。
howto.when: 当你把解析好的结构化文档和查询意图交给它、需要产出可审计的四色卡片时接管。解析置信度低时会给对应内容打上人工复核标记。

say.text: 用 extract 阶段从这份文档抽取事实蓝卡
say.note: 生成蓝卡并附来源片段

say.text: 跑 review 阶段生成风险黄卡
say.note: 黄卡交由监察院复核过度声明

say.text: 跑 propose 阶段给出行动红卡
say.note: 红卡由丞相府补全策略建议

howto.what_en: Turns a parsed structured document into four cards: a blue fact card with source snippets, a green explanation card, a yellow risk card, and a red action card. Each card carries its source and generation method.
howto.when_en: Use it when you supply a parsed structured document plus your intent and need an auditable four-color card report. Low parse confidence flags items for manual review.

say_en.text: Run the extract stage to pull fact blue cards from this document
say_en.note: Produces blue cards with source snippets

say_en.text: Run the review stage to generate the risk yellow card
say_en.note: Yellow card is rechecked for overclaiming

say_en.text: Run the propose stage to output the action red card
say_en.note: Red card is completed with next steps
